    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']

        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        pred_tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        norm_gain = gain / max(pred_tokens, 1)

            accepted.append(call_id)
        diagnostics.append({
            "accepted": accept,
            "call_id": call_id,
            "normalized_gain": round(norm_gain, 8)
        })
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }"}
